text_block_list.name: Mysterious Voice
text_block_list.text: Open your eyes... Please open your eyes...

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Voice
text_block_list.text:
Just jump right there... and shout...
Ah. Turn the penlight to your fave's color...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Woo-hoo! Is everyone having fun?!
Are you all enjoying our solo live~?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're finally awake, sleepyhead☆
Come on, hurry up, wave your penlight!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Indeed indeed! We're finally here at the arena!
The showstopper stage and the audience packed with glowing lights—all of it belongs to us, right?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Still, I want to keep running out in front. So, setting a new goal. My next target is—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: —Because it is space.

text_block_list.name: Fan Drifting in Space
text_block_list.text:
WOOOO! Escape Sisters--!!
You're the best! WOOOOOH!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (RINGGGGGGG!)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, looks like the farewell bell
is already ringing!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Then how about sprinting away
to a place where you can no longer hear that sound?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: “You're right. After all, we're the ones who will keep running at the very front to places no one has ever reached!”

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: That's right, we are—...

text_block_list.name: Falco and the Others
text_block_list.text: 'Cause we're the Runaway Sisters☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ringgggg...)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, good morning!
Actually, about today—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hellow-hellow~! Is this the studio for today?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yahoo! You called, so here I am,
ta-da-da-daaa!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Uhh. Hello.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: "Yeah, I invited everyone to come practice together today! The reason is, you see~"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Trainer? Hellooo?
You have this look like you just met destiny, are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Geez, the main event is just getting started!
Come on, pull yourself togetherâª

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: The harmony between these five is genuinely legendary! Won't you just give it a listen, just once?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, listening to the five of them sing,
it formed a wonderful harmony,
just as Smart Falcon had said.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Practicing together in a unit.
For <chrname>'s sake too,
that might be a good idea...
